# STS2 decision samples

The first payload of each decision type that the headless STS2 host
(sts2-cli on game v0.111.1) sent during random-bot runs, saved by
`bots/sts2_random_bot.py` (it writes them to `fixtures/` in its working
directory). To refresh: run the bot and copy `run/sts2-random/fixtures/*.json`
here.
